question: Magnetic field lines around a straight conductor carrying a current will always be:

options.text: parallel to the direction of current
parallel to the length of the conductor
perpendicular to the direction of current

solution:
The correct answer is __**perpendicular to the direction of current.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The** magnetic field lines around a straight conducto**r carrying a current are circular loops centered on the conductor.
